Game Overview

Undead Walking puts players into a scary experience centered on battle relentless zombie hordes in Undead Walking, where you are Brando, a survivor in a grim, atmospheric world. Wield your trusty shotgun and strategize to maximize kills while conserving ammo. Immerse yourself in eerie 3D pre-rendered graphics and enhance your arsenal to conquer the undead menace. Survive, strategize, and hunt!
